title: Adding a service is permission-gated and must offer the second destination
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Create and edit work orders, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A due service is visible on a work order, the worklist or the asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. As a user without Create and edit work orders, confirm adding is not available.
  2. As a permitted user, confirm Add offers the second destination (a new work order) as well as this one.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Adding a service is permission gated.
  • It must offer the second destination (a new work order), because a technician with three hours left cannot take on ten more lines.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10573 (S17, Add a service to a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S17; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S17-N1: “Adding a service is permission gated and must offer the second destination, because a technician with three hours left cannot take on ten more lines”
